text: The customer wants help fixing or replacing their smart plug (Order LM-51310) because it unexpectedly turns off around 2:00 AM every night. So far, the agent verified no app schedules are active and advised the customer to run a firmware update, which the customer is currently installing. Next, the customer will monitor the plug tonight and follow up tomorrow, at which point a replacement will be issued if the problem persists.
